verdict_reason: Wave 199 P5 baseline BLOCKED-ON-DATA was confirmed; Wave 200 P2 attempt to upgrade to GPU-sharded (option B per task spec) is ALSO blocked. Two compounding structural blockers.

blocker_1.summary: OmegaFold pins torch 1.13.1; the latest GPU build (cu116) tops out at sm_86; this host's GPUs (PRO 6000 + 5090) are sm_120 (Blackwell).
blocker_1.evidence: After installing torch==1.13.1+cu116 into /home/hugo/.venvs/omegafold_venv (2 GB wheel, ~50 s download), torch.cuda.is_available() returned False with UserWarning: 'NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Workstation Edition with CUDA capability sm_120 is not compatible with the current PyTorch installation. The current PyTorch install supports CUDA capabilities sm_37 sm_50 sm_60 sm_70 sm_75 sm_80 sm_86.' Same warning for the 5090. Reverted to torch==1.13.1+cpu to leave the venv in pre-wave state.

blocker_2.summary: All other project venvs with sm_120-capable torch (lineageflow_venv, flowmol3_venv, etc.) ship Python 3.12, which OmegaFold's setup.py explicitly rejects (Python 3.8/3.9/3.10 only).
blocker_2.evidence: Inventory of .venvs/*/bin/python (Python 3.10.x venv: omegafold_venv; Python 3.12.x venvs: lineageflow_venv, flowmol3_venv, geva_venv, hidream_venv, hpsv2_venv, image_reward_venv, kanzi_venv, lumina_venv, protbfn_venv, wan2_2_venv; Python 3.14.x venvs: dpg_venv, hpsv2_venv, image_reward_venv, kanzi_venv). No sm_120-capable torch exists for Python 3.10 (no later torch build is compatible with OmegaFold's code).

blocker_3.summary: Even if option A (CPU wrapper) were attempted, Wave 84's estimate of >40 h/arm at N=1000 still applies; the venv has CPU torch 1.13.1 and OmegaFold is a heavy model.
blocker_3.evidence: Wave 84 lineageflow_n1000_omegafold_q4_2026 notes; verified by inspection of /home/hugo/codes/flowa-multistep-reinference/verification_outputs/lineageflow_n1000_omegafold_q4_2026_baseline.json which records the N=5 smoke subset as the only data ever produced.

arm_basis: Synthetic Pfam-family AA sequences (4 families × 250 seqs each at full N=1000; N=5 subset per family at smoke5); folded by upstream OmegaFold; ESM-IF scored. Real LineageFlow ckpt not used in foldability path — foldability is a downstream metric, not a LineageFlow-eval. The Wave 199 P5 + Wave 200 P2 finding is therefore that the *foldability-N=1000 sweep* is blocked, not the LineageFlow upstream eval (which has its own Wave 109.B GPU-accelerated path via run_real_ckpt_eval.py that runs fine on the lineageflow_venv GPU stack).
qid_pairing_method: set(qids_base) == set(qids_fw) and len equal; qids are q0..q4 in both baseline and framework jsonls (smoke5 subset).
wall_min_actual_note: Sweep did not execute. 50-min budget unused. GPU torch install attempt was 50 s (download 2 GB) + 30 s (revert), within budget.
output_paths_committed_note: These are the Wave 87 N=5 smoke5 paths. They were NOT overwritten by Wave 200 P2 because the N=1000 sweep did not run (BLOCKED-ON-DATA). They remain the only honest per-record LineageFlow foldability data on disk. The task spec's expected output paths (verification_outputs/lineageflow_n1000_omegafold_q4_2026/baseline/{foldability,self_consistency}.jsonl) are NOT created because no N=1000 sweep ran; copying smoke5 into those paths would be a byte-identical rewrite of the existing data, which would not add new evidence.
cline_decision: B (GPU sharded direct invocation) attempted and BLOCKED-ON-DATA due to torch-version/CUDA-arch mismatch on Blackwell. Wave 199 P5 BLOCKED-ON-DATA annotation preserved; Wave 200 P2 adds the new GPU-arch blocker detail.
